channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period brought several concrete investment wins for Puerto Rico: CSL Plasma's $30M plasma-center expansion, Laser Light's $75M commitment tied to a DDEC-supported Caribbean HQ, Pentaq's $41M federal manufacturing contract, Marriott's $38M Isla Verde renovation, and continued renewable/water capital flows (Infinigen's $33M+ solar-storage financing, AES's 485MW coming online, PRASA's $129M Envocore meter contract, and the $45M Fort Buchanan microgrid). New Fortress Energy's court-approved 91% debt reduction removes a key overhang on the island's natural-gas supply, and steady FEMA disaster-recovery tranches ($100M+ and $81.9M) keep reinforcing infrastructure resilience.
